rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MCP server implementation by Guy Brown that provides AI assistants with complete access to the Fastly NGWAF (Next-Gen Web Application Firewall) API for managing web security configurations and monitoring attack patterns. Built using Node.js with axios for HTTP requests, the implementation offers tools for managing corporations and sites, creating and configuring security rules at both corp and site levels, handling IP whitelists/blacklists, managing custom lists for various data types, monitoring security events and suspicious IPs, setting up alerts for attack pattern detection, and analyzing security analytics with top attacks and timeseries data. The server includes context management for default corporation and site settings, supports CloudWAF instance management, user administration, and provides comprehensive coverage of Fastly's NGWAF API endpoints, making it valuable for security teams managing web application firewalls, DevOps engineers automating security configurations, and analysts requiring programmatic access to security event data and attack intelligence.
